policy: Required-if-applicable, never auto-certifies an implementation. Profiles: desktop, lan, saas, paid, ai, regulated, sync, mobile, multi_site, multi_owner, windows. Connectivity tier cloud_sync activates sync and saas.

controls.requirement: Describe the real economic buyer and five user jobs
One paid vertical slice, observable success/failure and exclusions
Compare available regional/world competitors with dates and price/feature links
controls.acceptance_evidence: G0 dated research; UNKNOWN where inaccessible

controls.requirement: Scope, pricing model, trial, support limit, cancellation and customer handoff
Shared tokens/navigation/table/form/error-state specifications
controls.acceptance_evidence: G2 design tokens and responsive screenshots

controls.requirement: Market-appropriate Arabic/English/RTL/LTR and locale/currency/time formats
Keyboard, focus order, labels, errors, contrast, WCAG 2.2 AA target for web UI
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 a11y audits and manual keyboard journey

controls.requirement: Loading/empty/saving/saved/error/denied/offline/retry states
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 actual browser journey and failure injection

controls.requirement: First-run guided sample and direct user help
controls.acceptance_evidence: G6 user succeeds with no developer

controls.requirement: Create unique admin at first run, secure recovery
Adaptive salted storage, login throttling and session revocation
Deny-by-default on endpoints, object, field and export
Customer users/roles and company profile with server checks
Customer-approved temporary vendor session scoped/revocable/logged
Production rejects static demo credentials or shortcuts
Classify private/finance/health/children data, ownership and retention
Record writer, time and correction; never silent hard-delete of financial history
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 audit and reverse operation checks

controls.requirement: Idempotency on create/payment/import/retry and concurrent edits
UI/exports totals agree with source; locale-safe dates/currency
Verified backup and independent clean-machine restore
controls.acceptance_evidence: G6 backup + different PC restore proof

controls.requirement: Schema/version change rehearsed, no silent data loss
Threat model for entrypoints, dependencies and trust boundaries
No secrets in repository/browser/logs and safe rotation
Validate input, output escape, prepared queries, file path control, CSRF where relevant
Appropriate TLS/loopback/LAN trust, secure cookies or tokens, timeout
Lock deps, license inventory, SCA, release build provenance
Vulnerability contact, patch policy, redacted logs, response owner
Features/seat/device limits authorized on trusted backend or verified local licence
Visible trial/active/grace/expired/renew/cancel states
No destructive lock; retain export/backup under expired plan
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 expired account export and backup test

controls.requirement: Signed local licences; public verification key; private key off device
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 tamper and offline grace test

controls.requirement: Verified provider webhook and idempotent reconciliation
Exact source->artifact SHA, changelog and rollback
Installer or hosted deployment proven on clean target environment
Recovery plan, support ownership, rollback and retention
Unit/integration/browser/security, negative/permission/migration/recovery
Expected repo/branch before write; PR+review; no force-push
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 PR source and changes review

controls.requirement: Queries, files, caches, jobs, exports, AI retrieval scoped to verified tenant
Hosted backups, monitoring, health checks, quotas, secret isolation
Allowed LAN interfaces, session and private network controls
Interrupted peer/network and safe conflict/replay handling
Agent tool access limited and auditable to current actor/org
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 untrusted prompt attempts to escalate

controls.requirement: Explicit approval for irreversible money/customer/destructive actions
controls.acceptance_evidence: G4 negative tool action under injection

controls.requirement: Source traceability, no fabricated success/evidence
Legal applicability, jurisdiction, data transfer, qualified reviewer
Explicit retention/access/rights/encryption, audit and independent security review
Each module exposes a versioned typed contract with documented failure codes and its own tests; no module reads another module's tables
controls.acceptance_evidence: Contract file, version policy and module test run without booting the whole app

controls.requirement: Every record carries org (and branch where relevant) scope from the first schema, including single-PC editions
controls.acceptance_evidence: Schema review and upgrade test standalone->cloud_sync without data rewrite

controls.requirement: Globally unique client-generated IDs (UUIDv7/ULID) and device-safe human document numbers; no reliance on autoincrement for identity
controls.acceptance_evidence: Two devices create records offline without ID or number collision

controls.requirement: Abrupt power loss or process kill during write, sync, backup or upgrade leaves data consistent
controls.acceptance_evidence: Kill-process and power-cut drill log on target device

controls.requirement: Cloud hub is the single record authority; devices hold scoped replicas plus transactional outbox; no peer-to-peer writes in v1
controls.acceptance_evidence: Topology diagram and failure-mode table reviewed

controls.requirement: Every synced entity classified A append-only / B field-merge / C hub-confirmed / D derived, with tested merge rule; money balances derived only
controls.acceptance_evidence: Entity class table and merge tests per class

controls.requirement: At-least-once delivery, idempotent apply by change_id, resumable batches, safe crash mid-batch
Ordering by hybrid logical clock or hub sequence, never device wall clock alone; author time bounded and flagged
Signed permission/entitlement snapshot per device with offline grace limit; hub re-authorizes at author time; rejected changes quarantined and visible
Admin-approved device enrollment, per-device key, revocation, lost-device runbook, local encryption where feasible
Devices receive only their org/branch/role scope; restricted fields never replicated; role change re-scopes and purges
controls.acceptance_evidence: Device data inspection after role change

controls.requirement: Protocol and payload versions; hub supports N and N-1; older clients read-only with update prompt; upcasters tested
Per-device pending count, last successful sync, conflicts and stale-device alerts visible to user and owner
controls.acceptance_evidence: UI screenshots plus stale-device alert test

controls.requirement: Tombstones and legal erasure propagate to every replica including offline ones on reconnect; outstanding replicas tracked
Point-in-time hub backup, scheduled export and local main-PC backup; hub restore bumps epoch so restored-away data is not resurrected
controls.acceptance_evidence: Hub restore drill with stale devices

controls.requirement: Deterministic simulation of partition, duplicate, reorder, clock skew, concurrent offline edits, kill mid-sync and version skew runs in CI
controls.acceptance_evidence: CI artifact of the 12-case suite in docs/CONNECTIVITY_AND_SYNC.md

controls.requirement: Declared hosting region, cross-border/processor legal review, encryption in transit and at rest before customer data leaves premises
controls.acceptance_evidence: Privacy review record naming region and reviewer

controls.requirement: Per-tenant storage/bandwidth/attachment quotas and measured hosting cost per customer before pricing the tier
Devices cache a signed cloud entitlement with bounded offline grace; expiry keeps read/export/backup
PWA served from trusted HTTPS origin with manifest, service worker and Android/iOS install guide
controls.acceptance_evidence: Install test on one Android and one iPhone

controls.requirement: Declared list of offline mobile actions (capture-only by default); everything else online; hub re-validates
controls.acceptance_evidence: Manifest mobile_offline_actions and denial test for undeclared action

controls.requirement: Persistent storage requested, unsynced count visible, warning before logout/clear; Safari eviction and no background sync handled
Camera/scan/print/push verified per platform with fallbacks (iOS push needs home-screen install, no WebUSB printing on Safari)
Touch targets, narrow RTL screens, slow mobile data, compact sync and Wi-Fi-only attachments
controls.acceptance_evidence: Throttled-network Playwright run and phone screenshots

controls.requirement: Branch dimension on records, per-branch roles and exports; cross-branch views only for permitted roles
Owner dashboards aggregate branches and show per-branch data freshness (last sync)
controls.acceptance_evidence: Dashboard test with one stale branch

controls.requirement: Adding/removing/demoting owners, billing transfer, org deletion and region change need owner quorum or documented vendor dispute process
All owners see audit of permission, money and admin changes; full export by any owner allowed and notified to others
controls.acceptance_evidence: Audit visibility and export notification test

controls.requirement: Commercial Windows builds are compiled (e.g. Nuitka core) without shipped Python sources/bytecode, debug off, and no secrets or private keys inside the binary
controls.acceptance_evidence: Build log plus secret scan of the packaged artifact

controls.requirement: Signed licence verified with fixed algorithm and purpose-separated keys; own-file hash check at start; clock-rollback guard
controls.acceptance_evidence: af-license tests plus tampered-file and clock-rollback drills on the shipped build

controls.requirement: Licensed customer name visible in the app and documents; activation/seat limit; updates, support and cloud features only for valid licences
Licence failure or expiry never deletes, hides or encrypts customer data; no hidden remote kill switch; expired = read/export/backup
controls.acceptance_evidence: Expired and invalid licence drills showing export and backup still work

controls.requirement: Trust stage recorded (ADR-0004): stage A ships unsigned only when installed by the vendor or via the verified updater, with Ed25519-signed installer/updates and published SHA-256; stage C requires Authenticode signing with timestamp under one publisher identity. Version info set; no UPX packing
controls.acceptance_evidence: Release record naming the stage; signature or SHA-256 check on the delivered artifact

controls.requirement: Update manifest signed with a separate update key and file hash verified by the app before installing; the delivery link itself is untrusted
Data and settings live outside the program folder; installer never overwrites/deletes them; verified backup before migration; automatic rollback on failure
controls.acceptance_evidence: Upgrade N-1 to N on a real-shaped synthetic DB, failed-migration rollback, uninstall keeps data by default

controls.requirement: Canary customer first, pause and rollback switch, security fixes delivered even to expired licences
Help button creates a ticket with a redacted diagnostic bundle the customer previews before sending; status visible in the app
controls.acceptance_evidence: Ticket round-trip test and bundle redaction test

controls.requirement: Self-check page: DB integrity, disk space, backup age, licence, sync, printer, version; every error has a code, Arabic message, next step and technical detail
Remote help only customer-initiated, time-boxed, visible, revocable and audited; no permanent unattended credentials by default; self-hosted relay where used
controls.acceptance_evidence: Session without grant refused; customer ends session; audit entry

controls.requirement: Heartbeat/error fields listed in the contract, no personal data, switchable except what a cloud tier needs to run

AI agents reach customer data only through the vendor control center: read by default, repo changes via PR and human merge, customer-side repair only from a tested allowlist under live grant, vendor approval and audit; tickets/logs treated as untrusted input
controls.acceptance_evidence: Prompt-injection ticket test and denied out-of-grant repair action

controls.requirement: Installation never asks the customer to disable antivirus, add broad exclusions or trust a vendor root certificate; false positives are submitted to Microsoft; Smart App Control handled with the customer owner's consent
controls.acceptance_evidence: Install checklist signed off on a clean Windows 11 PC

controls.requirement: Step-by-step guides for every daily job and role; every screen reachable from a guide
A 'Guide me' coach opens the page and outlines each named button; every step finds its button
'Solve a problem' section: every user-facing error and the coverage checklist, each with what/why/steps, a link to the page and a Guide me button
Help written in polished Egyptian Arabic a 12-year-old understands; reading pass by a non-developer each release
No slideshow on first sign-in; one line pointing to Help; tour only as opt-in
Every 'how do I' ticket adds or improves a guide or problem entry in the next release
controls.acceptance_evidence: Ticket log linked to help changes

controls.requirement: Isolated diagnostics module not shown in customer menus, started only by the vendor under an open grant with repair scope
controls.acceptance_evidence: Refused without grant; report with grant

controls.requirement: Probes for data, backups (test restore in a temp folder), network, sync, licence and program version/errors
Read-only, temp files only, no personal data or money in reports, every run logged on both sides
